---
title: Spatial UI
---

Build a movable, resizable card with text, an image, buttons, a slider,
and a toggle. Change image brightness, hide the photo, then reset the controls.
The existing elements update without rebuilding the UI tree.

Drag the card edge to move it or a corner to resize its layout. Two-source
scaling changes the whole card's scale; it is different from corner resizing.
Test the controls with mouse input and the available XR input sources.

[Build spatial UI](/sdk/ui) · [Simulator controls](/sdk/simulator) · [Example catalog](/examples)
